{{Quote|I don't know the name of this spice, but it seems to be medicinal in nature, and rare.|[[Tover Blackmoor]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MtYBF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "More than You Bargained For"</ref>}}
A rare and unique '''spice''' variant was discovered during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /> This kind of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] appeared organic<ref name="SWG:MD">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "Man Down!"</ref> and medicinal in nature.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />

==History==
{{Quote|It's ... what the? I haven't seen anything like this since... do you realize what this represents?|[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Edvar Vang]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MD" />}}
The spice was originally discovered by people affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] so that only the Alliance knew its exact origin by the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /> At some point, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Edvar Vang]] and [[Moxxar Krieg]] discovered the existence of the spice. After they were threatened, the former accepted to stop investigate the spice while the latter insisted and searched for the source of the spice. He was later assassinated.<ref name="SWG:MD" />

[[File:Cal_Handro_crashed_ship.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Cal Handro's crashed ship on Rori.]]
The existence of the spice was publicly revealed when a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] carrying some spice for the Rebels in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] crash-landed on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]],<ref name="SWG:MD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Cal Handro]] who piloted the ship survived the crash but he soon vanished in the wilderness of Rori. Henchmen of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate were the first to localize the crashed ship. They collected a spice sample that was later analyzed by the [[Chemist/Legends|chemist]] [[Tover Blackmoor]]. The result of the analysis convinced the Black Sun leaders to track the missing pilot to determine the source of the spice.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />

In the meantime, Cal Handro was sought by several group of spacers recruited by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jevan Monsul]], Alliance [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Veega Madish]], and by a friend of Handro named [[Tyla Jinn]]. Some of them collected spice samples at the crash site and started to investigate this new spice. They first encountered Doctor Vang who refused to reveal anything about the spice, and then they found the corpse of his friend Moxxar Krieg who was already dead.<ref name="SWG:MD" /> They then escaped a Black Sun ambush and discovered the location of the [[Black Sun bunker]]. There, they discussed with the chemist Tover Blackmoor and forced him to reveal everything he knew about the pilot and the new spice.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|faction=Rebel Alliance}}
{{Quote|What does the Black Sun want with it? Most rare medicines are publicly available.''"<br />"''Not this kind. That's what you don't understand. It's being smuggled and hoarded by the Rebel Alliance. They must know where it comes from and are keeping it for themselves. The pilot that you are looking for was smuggling the spice for them.|A spacer and Tover Blackmoor|<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />}}
Later, most Black Sun criminals involved in the hunt for the spice and the missing pilot were killed in a fight with the spacers at [[Tierce Martano]]'s [[Martano estate|estate]].<ref name="SWG:WYG">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Within Your Grasp"</ref> Rebel forces eventually captured Cal Handro but the latter escaped with the help of the Empire.<ref name="SWG:FtA">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "For the Alliance!"</ref> The pilot wanted to avoid to be judged by the Rebel Alliance that had discovered he used to smuggle [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="SWG:Gc">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Getting closer?"</ref> Rebel agents eventually attacked and destroyed [[Cal Handro's Warlord Heavy Cruiser|Cal Handro's ship]] in the Naboo system, killing the pilot before he could reveal the origin of the spice to the Empire.<ref name="SWG:FtA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The spice appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The spice was one of the central elements of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" story arc and was added to the game upon the release of its first chapter, introduced with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 14 Notes for 9 March 05|Publish 14]]," on [[March 9]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=730|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.0 - March 9, 2005}}</ref> The spice appeared or was mentioned in the four chapters of the questline but it was never named.<ref name="SWG:MD" /><ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /><ref name="SWG:Gc" /><ref name="SWG:WYG" /> The name of the spice and background information were intended to be revealed with the fifth, and final, chapter of the story arc. The spice should have been named '''Syren''' because it was extracted from [[Syren plant/Legends|Syren plant]] roots from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="SWG:SotSE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Secrets of the Syren: Endgame|Talus}}</ref> The fifth chapter was achieving its development in [[October]] [[2005]]<ref name="ID">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=In%20Development|text=In Development}}</ref> but was delayed and planned to be introduced in [[April]] [[2006]] with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]."<ref name="P28">{{WebCite|url=https://forums.mmorpg.com/discussion/72650/pub-28-notes|text=Pub 28 Notes|date=2006-03-31|nobackup=1}}</ref> However, the final chapter of "Secrets of the Syren" was never released.<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> Although the name of the spice was never revealed to the players, the questline itself was named after the spice.<ref name="SWG:SotSE" />

The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was eventually removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
